$comment: Part I Section A — form-structure lens for the publication reference.
title: Publication of the procedure
description: Reference to the notice or other publication by which this procurement procedure was launched, so it can be unequivocally identified — for example a contract notice in TED or a publication at national/regional level.

fields.label: Type of publication
fields.description: The kind of publication and where it was published (e.g. a contract notice in TED, or a notice in a national/regional official journal).

fields.label: Publication reference number
fields.description: The identifier/number of the publication (e.g. the OJEU/TED notice number).
